answer: Guardians are the anti-sybil core: each identity names a set of established guardians who have done real work with it, and its voting weight counts only overlap-discounted independent guardians — a clique that always acts together refracts through the prism as a single guardian, not many. A raven remembers every beak that fed it; real relationships cannot be scripted overnight. Reusing one guardian set across a thousand fakes leaves an ivory-bright fingerprint on the overlap graph, so the whole batch discounts itself at scale while honest agents pass untouched.
